dz: 克洛塔尔二世国王颁布"巴黎教条"(Editum Chlotacharii),这是一种法兰克语"大宪章"(Francish Magna Carta),它捍卫了法兰克语贵族的权利,同时将犹太人排除在法兰克语王国的所有民事就业之外.
de: King Chlothar II promulgates the Edict of Paris (Edictum Chlotacharii), a sort of Frankish Magna Carta that defends the rights of the Frankish nobles while it excludes Jews from all civil employment in the Frankish Kingdom.
